name: French
description: The French deploy powerful cavalry units and can boost production in fortified positions. Enemies must be prepared to withstand the charges of powerful Royal Knights and other armored units.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Royal Knights in the Feudal Age (II).
Town Centers work rate increased per age up +15%, +15%, +20%, +25%.
Trade Posts are revealed on the minimap.
Traders can return Food, Wood, or Gold to Markets.
Blacksmiths grant melee damage technologies for free after each age up.

overview.title: Royal Stallions
overview.description: Deploy the Royal Knight in the Feudal Age (II) and research powerful unique technologies for cavalry.

overview.title: Mainland Economy
overview.description:
Wield a superior economy with -50% cheaper resource drop-offs and -35% cheaper economic technologies.
Town Center production speed increased per age +15%, +15%, +20%, +25%.

overview.title: Trade Economy
overview.description:
Choose to return Food, Wood, or Gold to Markets with Traders and Trade Ships.
Trade Ships return +20% more resources.
Trade Posts are revealed on the minimap at the start of the game.
Docks provide populations space.

overview.title: Smithy's Grace
overview.description: Blacksmiths grant melee damage technologies for free after each age up.

overview.title: Influence
overview.description: Maintain offensives with -10% cheaper Keeps that reduce the cost of units produced from Archery Ranges and Stables within their influence by -20%.

overview.title: Unique Units
overview.description:
Royal Knight: Heavy Cavalry that gains +3 bonus damage for 5 seconds after completing a charge.
Arbalétrier: Crossbowman with +1 melee armor that can deploy a defensive Pavise to provide +5 ranged armor and +1 weapon range for 30 seconds.
Cannon: Bombard replacement with more damage, mobility and no setup time.
Galleass: Large war galley that has a long range forward mounted bombard.
War Cog: Unique Springald Ship with reduced cost and increased ranged armor.
